title: The Crown of the Marches: the Riven Court
changes: The Crown of the Marches is alive: Oathbroken Knights, shield-bearing Crownguard, Hollow Heralds whose decrees rally the court, blinking Court Magi, Gildhound packs, Crown Crows, Pretenders and the great Thronewardens roam its lands (levels 40 to 48).
Aldemar, the Riven King, waits on his throne of shards in the Throne Hall of the Crown Keep (level 50): watch for his Riven Edge, the falling crown shards and Kingsfall.
New quest chain from Herald-Marshal Ysmay Corrant in Tollcross: The Riven Throne, seven quests from the Pilgrims' Way to the Riven King.
